items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in this segment; the interviewer mentions Pee Wee Marquette in a note, but there is no evidence of a personal relationship or direct interaction between John Simmons and Pee Wee Marquette in the provided text.

ctx.x: And all of a sudden in -- it was like D-Day. Everyone emerged into the streets fighting. At the same time. Out of all of the clubs. Don Byas his -- hit somebody in the mouth with his horn; Benny Harris had broke his trumpet across somebody's head. And Teddy Reig, you remember Teddy Reig, big and fat as he has been-- somebody had him down beating the hell out of him, (laughter) a little bitty dude.
Don't tell me it was Pee Wee Marquette.
